description: Design business cards and get a print-ready PDF sheet: cards centred on A4 or Letter with crop marks (10 per sheet for 85 × 55 mm EU or 3.5 × 2 in US cards), plus a back side page mirrored for long-edge duplex printing. Four front templates (classic, band, centered, minimal), backs with your logo, a "scan to save my contact" vCard QR code, or blank; six colour themes or your own accent/paper/ink colours; optional logo and a vCard QR on the front. Also returns the vCard text. Print at 100% / actual size. Latin text only for now (the website also does an Arabic side). Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/business-card/

back.description: Back side: logo/company on the accent colour, a contact QR code, or none.

gap.description: Gap between cards in mm (0 = shared cut lines).

logo.description: Optional logo image: a PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/SVG file path or base64. Drawn as-is (keep it small).

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

qrFront.description: Also put the contact QR code on the front.

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

sides.description: Which pages to include (both = front page then mirrored back page).

name: doc_business_cards
title: Business cards PDF
